name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14
description: The ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 is a powerhouse ultraportable gaming laptop combining AMD's Ryzen 9 with RTX 4060 graphics in a 1.65kg chassis. The QHD+ 165Hz display delivers stunning visuals while the 76Wh battery provides all-day endurance for both gaming and productivity.

name: Dell XPS 15
description: The Dell XPS 15 blends premium craftsmanship with professional performance. Its stunning 3.5K OLED InfinityEdge display covers 100% DCI-P3 for vibrant, accurate colors. The compact design, CNC-machined aluminum chassis, and Thunderbolt 4 ports make it a top pick for professionals and creatives.

name: MacBook Pro 14-inch M3
description: The MacBook Pro 14-inch with M3 Pro chip delivers extraordinary performance for demanding workflows. Its Liquid Retina XDR ProMotion display, up to 22 hours of battery life, and a trio of Thunderbolt 4 ports make it the definitive professional portable for macOS power users.

name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carb Gen 1on1
description: The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 is the gold standard of business ultrabooks — weighing just 1.12kg with a MIL-SPEC-tested chassis. Intel's latest Evo platform, 2.8K IPS display, and legendary ThinkPad keyboard make it the top choice for enterprise users who demand reliability on the road.

name: Razer Blade 15
description: The Razer Blade 15 sets the benchmark for premium gaming laptops with CNC-machined aluminum unibody construction, an RTX 4070, and a blazing 240Hz QHD display. Vapour chamber cooling keeps thermals in check even during the most demanding gaming sessions.

name: HP Spectre x360 14
description: The HP Spectre x360 14 is a stunning 2-in-1 convertible featuring an OLED AMOLED touchscreen, 17-hour battery life, and Intel's AI-powered Core Ultra chip. The gem-cut chassis design and included stylus make it perfect for creatives who need versatility in a premium package.

name: Acer Predator Helios 16
description: The Acer Predator Helios 16 unleashes desktop-grade power with an RTX 4080 and Core i9-13900HX. Its Mini LED display delivers exceptional brightness and contrast, while the 5th-gen AeroBlade triple-fan cooling system maintains peak performance in extended gaming marathons.

name: Microsoft Surface Laptop 5
description: The Microsoft Surface Laptop 5 offers a refined, minimalist design with an Alcantara keyboard deck, vibrant PixelSense display, and Windows 11's best-in-class integration. It's the ideal everyday laptop for students and professionals who value elegance and simplicity over raw power.

name: ASUS TUF Gaming A15
description: The ASUS TUF Gaming A15 punches well above its price point with a military-grade MIL-STD-810H tested chassis, RTX 4060 graphics, and a 90Wh battery. The self-cleaning thermal system and anti-dust tunnels keep it cool and reliable for years of heavy gaming and study sessions.

name: LG Gram 17
description: The LG Gram 17 defies physics by fitting a 17-inch WQXGA display into a 1.35kg body built to MIL-SPEC-810H standards. With 80Wh battery life exceeding 19 hours and Intel EVO certification, it's the definitive laptop for users who need a large screen without compromising portability.
